_help: Act 2, the museum: hiring Dr. Arthur Pembroke (hired_pembroke), 700, or 500 if you haggle having researched the archive (researched_akmentar). Turning him down tells you about Hassan (knows_hassan). Wadi Natrun and his records (promised_pembroke_records) are on his rapport ladder. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: pembroke
already.line: My equipment is crated and labelled. Every crate. I trust yours is too.

first.speaker: pembroke
first.line: Dr. Arthur Pembroke, field archaeologist. Seven hundred pounds, in advance, and I run the excavation records.

homework.speaker: pembroke
homework.line: You're the one who signed out the Akmentar boxes. You've actually read them. Very well. Five hundred.

haggle.speaker: pembroke
haggle.line: I am not a porter to be haggled with. Seven hundred.

broke.speaker: pembroke
broke.line: Then try Dr. Hassan al-Masri in the old quarter. The museum dismissed him for less.

joined.speaker: pembroke
joined.line: Very well. I shall want a proper camera, and someone who can hold it still.
